clusters.headline: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC
clusters.summary: Roelf Meyer tells the BBC that being a white Afrikaner gives him legitimacy to challenge Trump's claim of a genocide.

clusters.headline: Africa: WHO Director-General's remarks at the High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response
clusters.summary: [WHO] New York -- Your Excellency Dr Khalilur Rahman, President of the General Assembly, Your Excellency Amar Bendjama, President of ECOSOC, My sister, Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohamed, The Right Honourable Helen Clark, Excellencies, dear colleagues and friends,

clusters.headline: Iranian President Pezeshkian brought a diplomatic tone to New York for UNGA. What did his remarks signal?
clusters.summary: Iran's president used his trip to New York this week for the UN General Assembly to signal openness to talks over the nuclear dispute. However, the chances of a major breakthrough on the war remain low.

clusters.headline: Najib Razak's 'solidarity fund' raises US$2.27 million, still short of US$12.27 million target: DPM Zahid
clusters.summary: The jailed former Malaysian prime minister’s eldest son told reporters that even if his father's frozen assets were released, his family would still be unable to immediately raise the fine for Najib to serve his sentence at home as part of a royal pardon.

clusters.headline: Cardiff City footballer Perry Ng receives Singapore citizenship, awaits FIFA clearance to represent Lions
clusters.summary: "Singapore has always been part of my family’s story, and over the years, it has become home to me too. I’m grateful for everyone who has supported me on this journey," says the 30-year-old defender.

clusters.headline: 'I knew it was my day': Singapore's Shanti Pereira retains Asian Games 200m gold, makes history
clusters.summary: Pereira is the first woman to win the event twice at the quadrennial event.

clusters.headline: Singapore's Loh Kean Yew beats world number 1 Christie, guaranteed historic Asian Games medal
clusters.summary: This is Loh's first win over Christie in 11 meetings.

clusters.headline: Brunei's crown prince to visit SAFTI City, oceanarium as part of five-day trip to Singapore
clusters.summary: Crown Prince Al-Muhtadee Billah will be in Singapore for the 12th edition of the Singapore-Brunei Young Leaders' Programme.

clusters.headline: 'Lithuanian skies are NATO skies': DW speaks with Lithuanian premier Mindaugas Sinkevicius
clusters.summary: In a DW interview, Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius discussed threats to Lithuania from Russia and Belarus, NATO's need for stronger air defense and why military spending alone cannot ensure security.

clusters.headline: More than 23,500 Simba customers affected in data breach involving IC numbers, birth dates
clusters.summary: "No credit card or bank account information is at risk," the telco said.

clusters.headline: Nigeria: Nigeria, U.S. Sign Framework to Attract Investment Into $700bn Mineral Resources
clusters.summary: [Premium Times] The framework is expected to use the relationship between the Nigerian and US governments as a foundation for business-to-business transactions and investment across Nigeria's mineral value chain.

clusters.headline: Killer Christa Pike is to be executed within days but her defence say she's a victim too
clusters.summary: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.
